kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَمْعَلَ • (šamʕala) Iq (non-past يُشَمْعِلُ (yušamʕilu), verbal noun شَمْعَلَة (šamʕala))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Univerbation of Hebrew שָׁמַע (šāmáʿ) equivalent to Arabic سَمِعَ (samiʕa) and شَمَلَ (šamala, “to compass”), regard بَسْمَلَ (basmala).
g: said of the manner in which the Jews or sometimes presbyters recite their scriptures
